title: mentha × verticillata subsp. acutifolia
intro: Mentha × verticillata subsp. acutifolia, commonly known as Japanese mint or Korean mint, is a subspecies of mint native to East Asia. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to alleviate digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Japanese mint include its use as a carminative, antispasmodic, and expectorant, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Japanese mint include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties and aroma.
